title: Ruflow launches 60 AI agents to optimize tasks and reduce costs #ruflow #aiagents #aitools
description: Ruflow launched the most powerful Claw tool that runs 60 AI agents simultaneously. It integrates directly with Claw, is ranked number one on GitHub, and is completely free. Ruflow’s AI agents collaborate by sharing a collective memory, continuously improving through every task cycle. It dynamically assigns simpler tasks to cheaper models and complex ones to more powerful models, optimizing token consumption by up to 50% while boosting cloud efficiency by 250%. This open-source innovation demonstrates a major leap in multi-agent AI orchestration, offering significant improvements in resource management and task automation for developers and enterprises working with AI workflows. #Ruflow #ClawAI #OpenSourceAI #MultiAgentAI #GitHubTopProject #AITool #AIOptimization #CloudEfficiency #AIAutomation #AIWorkflow #TokenSaving #TechInnovation #ArtificialIntelligence
